title: PostHog Personal API key (phx_): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 5 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: PHX_ vs the documented lower-case phx_, prefix: ph_, missing the role letter, and prefix: phc_, the public project token, in place of the secret prefix, and 2 more. Twin of "PostHog Personal API key (phx_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of posthog-token-bearer-header: prefix: phx- in place of phx_. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
